roles.title: Technical Director
bullets: Manage TVM's CAD $15,000 equipment budget and inventory for a 150-member student television service.
Diagnosed server noise with IPMICFG and power-supply A/B tests and identified a 1 Gb/s NAS bottleneck.
Lead student workshops on camera and audio workflows and advise campus productions on equipment and setup.

roles.title: Assistant Technical Director
bullets: Supported students with cameras, microphones and editing software, maintained equipment inventory and advised productions on gear selection.

projects.title: Grailed Plus
bullets: Extended an open-source resale tool into a published Chrome extension that compares Grailed, Depop and eBay listings. Added on-device image reranking in a Web Worker.
Built an eBay gateway with OAuth token caching and parallel text/image search. Returned initial matches before image reranking and retained them if inference failed or timed out.

projects.title: Discord Shoot Manager
bullets: Adapted EmailVerify into TVM membership and production workflows with administrator roster previews, atomic SQLite updates, role reconciliation and private shoot workspaces.
Tested that a roster replacement advances the SQLite snapshot once when Discord fails to acknowledge it, and that the same confirmation cannot be reused.

projects.title: Photo Node-Gallery
projects.technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, D3.js, Supabase, Cloudflare R2
bullets: Built a force-directed photo archive for browsing by colour. Compared five colour-similarity configurations on judged candidates for seven searches in a saved 100-photo archive.
Added atomic graph registration and upload recovery. Tested rollback, stale updates and retries after lost responses, and served published images from R2 through a shared media Worker.

projects.title: Bot or Not
bullets: Compared five classifier families for English and French bot detection using shard-grouped validation, language-specific thresholds and reproducible selection reports.
Audited checked-in practice data and found account timelines shared with training inputs. Documented why historical practice F1 scores do not establish unseen-data performance.

projects.title: bur1alrites
projects.technologies: Next.js, React Three Fiber, Three.js, HLS
bullets: Built a 3D video portfolio for a lighting artist with adaptive rendering quality and HLS previews, including stale-player cleanup and bounded playback retries.
Implemented multipart uploads to R2 and FFmpeg processing for HLS renditions and posters, with retries for failed parts and finalization while the page stays open.

projects.title: Elliot Mairet photography archive
bullets: Built a client photography archive with palette-based navigation and authenticated publishing, integrating image validation and colour extraction into uploads.
Preserved the original publication payload when retrying after lost responses. Tested identical retry requests even when form values changed.
